title: Phased entrenchment of batching/caching guardian for safe Optimize recommendations
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Build a ‘Guardian’ orchestration layer that phases Optimize-generated batching and KV-cache recommendations into production with progressive entrenchment policies, simulated soak, operator approval checkpoints, and observable rollback triggers. This ticket designs the rollout choreography, safety thresholds, operator UX hooks, and the automated revert playbook so that Optimize suggestions can be adopted automatically in low-risk contexts and require human approval when thresholds are breached.

Why: Current Optimize suggestions (batch size, KV cache TTL, caching granularity) are high-value for unit-cost reduction but risky when applied broadly. We need a middle-ground mechanism that provides automation benefits without increasing customer risk or causing SLA regressions.

Scope:
- Define the entrenchment state machine (stages: suggested -> staged-canary -> soak -> entrenched) and transitions.
- Implement telemetry gating: per-route latency, p99, error-rate, token-per-second deltas, and cost-per-token signals.
- Canary simulation harness that can run suggestions on mirrored or sampled traffic and produce an automatic forensic summary.
- Operator approval matrix UI/CLI hooks: autopermit for low-impact changes, manual approval for medium/high impact.
- Automated rollback playbook with reasoned rollback causes, snapshotting of previous model/config state, and one-click revert.
- Audit trail entries and links to PRs, Confluence runbooks, and incident dashboards.

Non-goals: full execution of suggestion generation (Optimize service produces suggestions) and model-level kernel changes. We only orchestrate adoption and safety checks for config-level recommendations.
acceptance_criteria: State machine documented in Confluence with transition rules and timeouts
Telemetry gating implemented and exposed as evaluators in the orchestrator (p95/p99 latency, error-rate, cost delta)
Canary harness can run suggestions against 1% mirrored traffic and produce a run summary with statistical comparison to baseline
Operator UX includes explicit approval prompts for medium/high impact suggestions and clear abort/revert buttons
Automated rollback executes in under 3 minutes and restores previous config + emits an incident note to the runbook dashboard
Audit logs and links created for every automated adoption (who/what/when/why)
tasks: Design entrenchment state machine and timeouts (Maya)
Build canary traffic mirror hook and summary generator (ENG infra)
Add operator approval endpoints to the Console API (Console team collaboration)
Create rollback orchestration and snapshot storage (Storage/Runtime)
Write Confluence runbook for on-call and manual rollback steps
Add telemetry dashboards and automated alert rules for guardrail breaches
